name: se2
description: Generate repository-scoped Feature issues and vertical Task dependency graphs with explicit dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Prototype graph-declared Feature and Task planning.
interface.longDescription: SE2 is an experimental issue-first, graph-first Feature planning plugin. Its Feature skill starts from repository AGENTS.md context, keeps a Mermaid overview, a canonical node registry, and one standard Markdown contract for every workflow step. It converges one repository-owned Feature issue containing the canonical Feature definition with vertical Task issues, an acyclic Task dependency graph, readiness evidence, coordinated multi-repository Feature links, and an internally verified GitHub publication step when explicitly authorized.
defaultPrompt: Use $se2:feature to converge repository-owned Feature issues and their vertical Task dependency graphs, including Feature maintenance when requested, then return the complete bundle and GitHub verification when publication is explicitly authorized.
